## bijection_verdict
**PASS** — no KB-BIJECTION RED. Observation O-1 (not a KB defect): the overwrite `replaced_by` texts carry factor-decided quantities ("less the credited days", "starting odometer", "the reading", "less the days the store gave free", "every amount … on the repair order") into the assembly that the computation documents must carry; the computation documents render them as neutral assembly words ("net of any days of the term credited to the holder", "the term's starting odometer … less the reading", "Any days the store gave free are deducted") without a tier, a condition or a pointer, and the baseline definitions in the same documents (effective date, certified odometer, term start odometer) keep the fall-back definite (blind fall-backs 3714.88 / 1797.80 / 350.00 all computed). Recorded for the source side's awareness only.
